labels.text:
Use the game only if you meet the regional
minimum age for simulated gambling and local
law allows access.

labels.name: Text:Coins are entertainment item
labels.text:
Coins are entertainment items with no cash
value. They cannot be redeemed, transferred,
sold or exchanged for real-world prizes.

labels.name: Text:Coin packs are consumable Ap
labels.text:
Coin packs are consumable Apple In-App
Purchases. Apple handles payment and
refunds; server verification is required before
delivery.

labels.name: Text:Rules and paytables determin
labels.text:
Rules and paytables determine results. RTP is
a long-run estimate, not a promise that an
individual session will win.

labels.name: Text:Automation, tampering, trans
labels.text:
Automation, tampering, transaction fraud,
account resale and exploits are prohibited and
may result in correction or restriction.
